action.command:
pip3 install paramiko -q && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
import os
c = paramiko.SSHClient()
c.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
c.connect('46.202.154.25', 22, 'root', '2N00py123+++')

# Configure git and commit
c.exec_command("""cd /opt/areloria
git config user.name "openhands"
git config user.email "openhands@all-hands.dev"
git add -A""")

# Find the remote
stdin, stdout, stderr = c.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria && git remote -v")
print("Remote:", stdout.read().decode())

c.close()
EOF
